_comment: Authorization policy for the two-button demo (18012-3 11.2.4).
Read-only in the gateway: these tables are memoryType 'sp' (Secret
Programmed) -- secret, preset, and not changeable over HES-CLME.
Edit this file and restart to change authorization.
The demo: two buttons both drive the SAME light, so the binding map's
authorType ('at') cannot tell the senders apart -- it is a property of the
row. Each button's message therefore carries a credential ('ci'), and the
row's input declares ap='au', so the decision is made per message.
This policy grants 'parent' a permission for the row whose authorType is
/lx/ob/bm/ot1/op1/at (button 1, di=6) but grants nothing for button 2's row
(/lx/ob/bm/ot2/op1/at). Absence of a permission fails closed, so button 1
may turn on the light and button 2 may not -- even though button 2 presents
a perfectly valid credential. Authorization is per target, not merely
The credential below is a demo secret. Never log or expose credInfo.
